description: 公共施設一覧(庁舎等)(小郡市) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 小郡市. 小郡市の庁舎等の施設情報です。 令和6年5月より自治体標準データセット「公共施設一覧」に準拠したフォーマットで公開しています。. Coverage: 小郡市. The portal files it under the publisher 小郡市. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設, 小郡市, 施設, 自治体標準ODS. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-12-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
